image_manifest.description: Stylized 3D animated feature scene: climax of a pterosaur race at a floating finish line with a clear winner. FINAL ART ONLY — do not draw asset id labels, callout dots, A1–A9 markers, watermarks, or annotation overlays.

elements.name: Header Text
elements.description: Blue and yellow, stylized, irregular 3D block text reading 'RACING PTEROSAURS!' at the top of the image.

elements.name: Victory Text
elements.description: Bold, celebratory 3D block text reading 'PLAYER WINS!' at the bottom of the image, styled to match the header.

elements.name: Winning Pterosaur
elements.description: Gigantic slender pterosaur in a full-speed flight pose, neck extended forward, clearly ahead and inches from the finish sash.

elements.name: Trailing Racer 1
elements.description: Colorful crest pterosaur mid-air behind the leader, wings flapping vigorously.

elements.name: Trailing Racer 2
elements.description: Compact pterosaur on the opposite side of the leader, showing effort to catch up.

elements.name: Floating Finish Line Sash
elements.description: Vibrant red checkered finish line sash stretched horizontally across the air, held aloft by colorful balloons at each end.

elements.name: Canyon Environment
elements.description: High-altitude view of flame-orange and sunset-red sandstone canyon walls below, motion blur streaks, clear bright sky.
